prompt: A stone is projected vertically upwards with an initial speed of 18.0 m s^-1. Neglecting air resistance and using g = 9.81 m s^-2, calculate the time taken for the stone to reach its maximum height.
solution: At maximum height, final velocity v = 0. Using v = u - gt: 0 = 18.0 - 9.81 t => t = 18.0 / 9.81 = 1.83 s.
